## What improves for the reader?

Describe the problem and the resulting change.

## Evidence

Link the original source or test record. For music results, include the tool, model, date, settings and a shareable output. Label untested exercises as untested.

## Validation

- [ ] I checked local links, anchors and rendered images.
- [ ] I credited sources and have permission to share submitted material.
- [ ] I updated affected language pages and regenerated mobile pages.
- [ ] I ran the four checks listed in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] I removed private account information, receipts and unshared recordings.

## Preview

For layout changes, include a screenshot or a description of the desktop/mobile preview reviewed.
